elements.label: Mouse cursor travelling from text area to Cancel button

pattern.description: Real screen-recorded cursor moves down out of the feedback text area (I-beam to arrow/not-allowed to hand pointer) and lands on the Cancel button, which picks up a grey hover background.
pattern.why_premium: The cursor change (I-beam, arrow, pointer) and button hover state confirm the target before the click, so viewers can follow the demo action without narration; it is raw screen capture rather than a designed move.

build_hint.gsap: Cursor sprite: gsap.to(cursor, {x, y, duration: 0.27, ease: 'power2.out'}); swap cursor glyph (text -> default -> pointer) with set() at path milestones; on arrival gsap.to(button, {backgroundColor: '#ebecf0', duration: 0.1, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate cursor x/y over ~8 frames at 30fps with Easing.out(Easing.quad) (or spring {damping: 30, stiffness: 200, mass: 1} for no overshoot); switch cursor image by frame threshold; button background toggles to hover colour on the arrival frame.

notes: Unpolished screen recording; b01 contains both the hover background change and the cursor tip on the end frame. No SFX candidates; audio is music bed under narration.
